title: 伊芙琳·挑个靠垫
description: 紫色伊芙琳穿完整宽松外衣，抱着柔软靠垫挑选布样，标志长尾状附肢安静卷曲。

art_direction.medium: thick wax crayon on warm paper
art_direction.identity: Evelynn is an adult lavender-skinned demon woman with swept magenta hair, bright golden eyes, pointed ears, and two long tapering lashers arching from her back. Preserve those recognizable colors and appendages while removing any seductive presentation. Give her a fully covering loose violet jacket, opaque trousers, soft gloves, and boots; keep the lashers resting in gentle rounded curves with harmless-looking tips.
art_direction.scene: She sits in a small sunny sewing nook, hugging a round cushion while comparing two simple pastel fabric squares laid on the table. Her expression is mischievously pleased rather than alluring. The lashers curl quietly behind the chair without touching anyone, and a single spool basket and window frame make a tidy original domestic scene.
art_direction.palette: lavender skin, magenta hair, deep violet, pale peach
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
